title: AI & Data Solution Engineer / Tech Lead
description:
Utveckla intelligenta, datadrivna lösningar som automatiserar och optimerar verksamhets- och produktflöden i tekniskt avancerade miljöer.
Vill du utveckla intelligenta och datadrivna lösningar med tydlig verksamhetsnytta? Här får du arbeta med hela kedjan, från data och AI till integration, programvaruutveckling och driftsättning.
Om rollen
Arbeta i ett team som bygger AI- och datalösningar för komplexa verksamhets- och produktflöden.
Bidra till lösningar som automatiserar, optimerar och effektiviserar processer.
Rollen kan anpassas mot utvecklare eller Tech Lead med produktägaransvar.

Det här kommer du göra
Utveckla lösningar inom AI, datahantering och backend.
Bygga och förvalta datapipelines samt integrera system och affärssystem.
Implementera generativ AI, AI-agenter och RAG-lösningar.
Delta i integration och driftsättning i moln- och lokala miljöer.
Som Tech Lead leda det tekniska arbetet och samtidigt bidra i utvecklingen.

Vi söker dig som har
Relevant högskole- eller universitetsutbildning inom datateknik, IT, AI, data science eller programvaruutveckling.
Praktisk erfarenhet av AI- och dataplattformar samt systemintegration.
Förmåga att arbeta genom hela leveranskedjan, från idé till produktionssatt lösning.
God kommunikationsförmåga på svenska och engelska.

Teknik & Verktyg
Machine Learning, generativ AI, AI-agenter och RAG.
Azure och AWS.
Kubernetes, Airflow, Kafka och Spark.
Iceberg, DataHub och dataplattformar i lokala miljöer.

Praktisk information
Ort: Göteborg.
Arbetssätt: Ej specificerat.
Språk: Svenska och engelska.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.
We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.
Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.
Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.


The Role
Etraveli Group relies on a massive scale of data to drive decision-making, analytics, and machine learning across Finance, Customer Service, Sales, and Data Science. To support our ambitious growth targets and the ongoing transformation of our data platform, we are looking for a skilled Data Engineer to serve as a pivotal technical engine in our Data Platform team.
You will work closely with our business stakeholders, analysts and data scientists defining data solutions and implementing data products that solve their needs. You will bridge the gap between raw, distributed data sources and high-performing data products, bringing critical data into our lakehouse platform and preparing it for diverse users. You will support the growth of our modern, scalable data warehouse solutions, ensuring our data pipelines are reliable, secure and deeply integrated into our tech ecosystem.
This is not a purely isolated technical role. The right person can understand underlying business needs – from pricing and conversion to revenue optimization – and answer questions on feasibility by selecting the right industry-leading frameworks, ETL patterns and orchestration tools. You will build solutions that don't just look conceptually good, but actually deliver robust data quality and solve high-stakes complexities within Etraveli.
The role will be based in Gothenburg.


Main tasks
Design, develop, and maintain robust batch and streaming pipelines tailored to business intelligence, machine learning and other stakeholders needs.
Interpret, analyse and ingest data from a variety of cloud and on-premise source systems into our expanding data lakehouse platform.
Evaluate, integrate, and configure industry-leading frameworks and tooling for our Data Engineering platform, prioritizing scalability, optimization/performance and maintainability.
Define and enforce rigorous data quality standards, implementing relevant monitoring and alerting solutions to ensure high data integrity.
Work closely with ML Engineers, core backend developers, DBAs, and business stakeholders to prioritize information needs, create synergies and optimize existing data pipelines.
Ensure high-performance data processing and query execution by applying techniques like indexing, partitioning, caching and efficient data modeling.
Champion technical excellence by promoting best practices in data engineering, sharing status updates, and contributing to a culture of continuous learning within the team.

Requirements
5+ years of experience in data engineering, data warehousing or a comparable technical role
Strong foundation in data warehousing concepts (Star and Snowflake schemas, Slowly Changing Dimensions, Incremental Loads) and translating business requirements into optimal data models
Proven hands-on experience building and testing batch and streaming pipelines. Familiarity with distributed query engines and processing tools (Spark, dbt, Dremio/Trino, Databricks) as well as orchestration (Airflow)
Proficiency in SQL and multiple scripting/programming languages such as Python, Scala and Bash.
Deep understanding of data lakehouse architectures, utilizing object storage (S3/Ceph), modern table formats (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake for ACID transactions/time-travel) and data formats (Parquet, Avro, JSON, CSV).
Experience with distributed messaging systems (Kafka) and Change Data Capture (CDC) tools (Debezium, Flink CDC, Kafka Connect).
Comfortable working with Linux, Docker and Kubernetes. Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Artifactory) and monitoring/alerting stacks (Grafana, Kibana). Note: Experience with secrets management (Vault) is a strong merit.

Benefits
At the Etraveli Group Gothenburg office, you will be part of +200 people, all with different cutting-edge skills and personalities. Our shared ambition, passion, and strong work ethic are what drive us toward the same goals. This foundation allows us to value our individual differences, which we believe are precisely what make us a strong team. With us you can enjoy:
Our office is located in Merkurhuset in Gothenburg, a few steps away from public transport and lunch restaurants.
We work on a hybrid-model where you can choose to work two days from home and you have two weeks per year that you can choose to work from a remote location
We love gaming and after work activities.
We know the value of personal development and continuous training.
Hackathons and Dev Weeks - We believe in promoting creativity and trying new things.
Healthcare allowance – Each employee receives a maximum allowable amount each year according to the Swedish Tax Agency to spend on health-promoting activities such as a gym card, massage etc.
Pension and health insurance – Through partners we offer a comprehensive pension and health insurance so that you can get help quickly in case of an accident.
Daily breakfast – To kick the day off just right, breakfast is available at the office every morning.

title: Senior Scientist - Clinical AI
description:
About AstraZeneca and AISI
At AstraZeneca, technology and science meet to change what is possible for patients. We are building a connected, end-to-end Enterprise AI engine that unites data foundations, AI technology, process reinvention, and business-facing AI to accelerate results across the whole value chain. Success depends on being an exceptional connector: you will leverage existing capabilities, promote reuse, share breakthrough ideas across geographies and functions, and focus on scaling impact rather than building in isolation.
AI Science & Innovation (AISI) sits at the centre of AstraZeneca's R&D AI transformation. Our remit is to build, buy, and deliver the AI models and agents that change pipeline outcomes, across discovery, translational science, biomarkers, and clinical development.
Within AISI, the BioPharma Clinical Development AI team is building world-class AI capability to accelerate the design, conduct, and analysis of clinical trials across our BioPharmaceuticals pipeline, in both early and late phase programmes. We partner closely with clinical development, regulatory, and biometrics teams to bring better treatments to patients faster, while adhering to the highest evidentiary standards.
The Opportunity
Clinical development is one of the most data-rich and decision-intensive parts of bringing a new medicine to patients. Trial design, patient selection, dose optimisation, biomarker strategy, and safety evaluation are all areas where AI and machine learning can add rigour, speed, and precision, as a powerful complement to clinical and statistical expertise.
You will work in cross-functional teams across the key BioPharmaceuticals disease areas of cardiovascular, renal, metabolic disease, respiratory, and immunology. Alongside experienced data scientists and clinical collaborators, you will apply modern AI methods to measurably advance the drug pipeline and help build reusable approaches that scale across programmes.
Foundation models, agentic systems, and causal AI are advancing rapidly, and the regulatory and methodological frameworks around them are evolving in parallel. In this role you will be hands-on at the frontier, developing, evaluating, and deploying AI methods that directly inform clinical trial design and decision-making. Every model you contribute to will eventually touch a trial that decides whether a patient gets a better therapy. That is the bar we hold ourselves to.
What You'll Do
* Develop and deploy AI/ML methods for clinical trials, including trial design support, dose optimisation, biomarker discovery, digital twins, predictive modelling, and safety and efficacy signal detection
* Contribute to end-to-end project delivery, from problem framing and methodology selection through to validation and adoption within study teams, with guidance from senior colleagues on more complex initiative.
* Partner with Clinical Development, Biometrics, and Regulatory colleagues to embed AI approaches into study design and decision-making
* Build reusable, well-documented data products such as pipelines, packages, and applications, with a software engineering mindset
* Apply modern methodologies including foundation models, agentic AI, generative patient models, longitudinal modelling, Bayesian inference, and causal inference, with clear evaluation criteria
* Practise data-centric AI and contribute to evaluation and benchmarking frameworks suitable for clinical and regulatory settings
* Engage with internal and external scientific communities, contributing to publications and conference presentations
Essential Requirements
* A degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g. Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, Biomedical Informatics, Computational Biology, Physics, Engineering) at Master's, or PhD level, or equivalent experience
* Demonstrated experience in AI/ML method development, shown through delivered models, publications, open-source contributions, or applied projects, ideally in clinical, biomedical, or drug development settings
* Hands-on experience with biological or clinical data, such as molecular (DNA, RNA, protein), imaging, or clinical text (EHR, clinical notes)
* Technical capability in one or more modern AI areas, such as foundation model training and fine-tuning, Bayesian inference, temporal and longitudinal modelling, multimodal integration, model interpretability, or post-training and alignment
* Strong Python skills, experience with PyTorch and modern LLM tooling, and familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex methods into actionable insights for clinical, regulatory, and scientific audiences
Desirable Skills and Experience
* Exposure to clinical development, such as trial design, biomarkers, dosing, safety, endpoints, or regulatory processes
* Experience with MLOps/LLMOps, uncertainty quantification, or clinical AI benchmarking
* Peer-reviewed publications in clinical AI, computational drug development, or machine learning
How You Work
* You are comfortable using, but not over-relying on, agentic AI tools to augment your work.
* You keep up with the latest AI research and try out new tools and methods without waiting to be directed.
Work policy
When we put people in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. This role is located in Gothenburg, Sweden and is not available for remote work or with travel or commuting support.
 
So, What's Next?
Are you ready to build AI that matters, at the intersection of machine learning, clinical science, and real patient impact? Submit your CV and cover letter no later than November 6, 2026.
